notes:
A versatile verb describing the process of something spreading out, unfolding, or progressing. In business and narrative contexts, it means to develop or expand. In military or emergency contexts, it means to deploy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{展開|てんかい}する: expand a business
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{展開|てんかい}する: develop an argument
- ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{展開|てんかい}する: carry out activities
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧: the development of a story
- ⟦{急|きゅう}{展開|てんかい}→急展開：19131_kyuutenkai⟧: sudden turn of events

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧: to develop; to grow — emphasizes growth or progress toward maturity, often used for economies, relationships, or technologies
- ⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to expand; to enlarge — focuses on increasing in size or scale, such as markets or influence
- ⟦{進展|しんてん}→進展：14374_shinten⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make progress — emphasizes forward movement or advancement of a situation
